quote: You carry grief in quiet places, hiding the ache from passing eyes. Every smile requires a heavy mask, pretending the wound is finally healing. But the dark returns when midnight falls, whispering secrets you cannot erase. Stop fighting the ghosts inside your mind, and let the quiet sorrow breathe. Peace arrives only when you finally weep.
